criteria.title: Configure a serial transport with explicit framing and timeout behavior.

passages: Canonical and noncanonical mode: VMIN/VTIME cases and O_NONBLOCK qualification

criteria.task: Configure only a newly owned PTY pair for 8N1-style service parameters and explicit raw/noncanonical read policy, read back supported settings, and restore on exit. Keep the actual baud claim pending on a physical UART.
criteria.purpose: A successful termios call proves electrical baud/framing on a PTY.

reasoning: A successful termios call proves electrical baud/framing on a PTY. Refute this explanation with the smallest relevant state or execution.
